profiles.name: Chitine
speciesTraits: Small Monstrous Humanoid. +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, −4 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. from the creature type.
Small size gives +1 on attack rolls and to AC, +4 on Hide checks, and three-quarters the carrying capacity of a Medium creature.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.
Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.

Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Racial skill points are 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Balance, Climb, Craft (trapmaking), Hide, Jump, and Move Silently.
LA +2. A chitine with only racial Hit Dice is ECL 4. One class level gives ECL 5.
Undercommon is automatic. The Chitine region also grants Common and lists Drow Sign, Elven (drow dialect), Kuo-Toan, and Orc as bonus languages. Favored class Rogue.
Chitines spin silk and use hardened webbing for building and equipment. Their racial traits give no combat web attack.

npcBuilds.name: Qid Lowweb

build.title: Chitine gallery scout, Rogue 1
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Chaotic neutral. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4 and size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +9, Will +3.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.
Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity for the light short swords. Trapfinding. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 to eligible hits.
actions: One Small short sword +7 melee for 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2.

Four light short swords as a full attack with Multiweapon Fighting. Each attacks at +5. The primary sword deals 1d4+1 piercing and each off-hand sword deals 1d4 piercing. All threaten on 19–20 and deal ×2 on a critical hit.
While dazzled, the single attack is +6, the full-attack swings are +4 each, and Search is +3.
build.tactics: Qid circles the party along the ceiling with her hands free, then descends to a ledge. She draws her swords once she has footing and uses the four-sword full attack when she can stay in place.

npcBuilds.motive: Find a way past the blocked gallery without alerting the guards.
npcBuilds.hook: Qid spots a ledge above the sentries where her four blades can reach them.

npcBuilds.name: Awa Spinner

build.title: Chitine silk rigger, racial Hit Dice only
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).
traits: Chaotic good. Unarmored, Dexterity +3 and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. BAB +2, grapple +3. Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +3.
Climb 20 ft. with a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks. Can take 10 even when rushed or threatened. Hooked palms and feet allow climbing walls and ceilings as with spider climb.
Grappling Bonus (Ex) gives +4 on grapple checks, offsetting the −4 Small size modifier. Difficult to Disarm (Ex) gives +4 on the opposed check to keep hold of a weapon.
Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex). Sunlight and bright magical light such as daylight dazzle a chitine, imposing −1 on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks.
Multiweapon Fighting is a racial bonus feat. Short swords count as simple weapons for weapon familiarity.
Weapon Focus (short sword) adds +1 on attack rolls with that weapon.
actions: One Small short sword +5 melee for 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. As a single attack it is +4 while dazzled.
When crossing the rafters, use Climb +14 and take 10 even while threatened for a result of 24. Keep hands free when using the ceiling route.
build.tactics: Awa checks the silk stays above the broken gangway. He climbs past the damaged section, takes footing on a brace, and draws a short sword if someone threatens the crossing.

npcBuilds.motive: Keep the damaged gangway open until everyone reaches the near side.
npcBuilds.hook: Awa can reach the damaged silk stays from the ceiling.
